reviews.text:
The decision to get a dog is almost as important as preparing to welcome it.

Choosing Elsa as our dog trainer for Zola, a Golden Retriever, meant choosing to learn a great deal about animal and human behavior, discovering creative strategies for better family life with an animal, deconstructing myths, and adapting routines.

The support she provided was fundamental in allowing us to fully experience this journey and surrender to the wonders of life with a furry friend by our side.

We highly recommend her work and thank her for everything she taught us!

Elsa is a professional who educates with gentleness. My Ziggy started out reactive, and nowadays he's a much calmer dog. We can enjoy walks without stress and while respecting his needs. I learned a lot about Ziggy from Elsa. I recommend her without hesitation!

We sought out Elsa in February after adopting Lucky, a 5-month-old puppy with deep trauma caused by abuse.
Throughout these months, Elsa has always been with us through every stage and has given us tools that have allowed for extraordinary progress in just 6 months.
Today, Lucky is a more confident, balanced, and above all, happy dog.
We highly recommend Elsa's services to anyone who wants to understand, educate, and help their furry friends!

Our experience with Elsa Mendes was simply excellent.

From the first contact, she demonstrated enormous professionalism, dedication, and attention to the needs of our Jack Russell and the whole family. Before and after each session, she prepared specific study materials, which allowed us to better understand the process and continue the training at home.

One of the aspects we valued most was the fact that the work wasn't limited to training the dog. Elsa is truly concerned with educating the whole family, teaching us to communicate and act consistently to achieve the best results.

Throughout the entire process, she maintained close contact with us through a WhatsApp group, clarifying doubts, monitoring progress, and adjusting strategies whenever necessary.

We felt that the training plan was completely personalized for our dog, respecting his personality and needs. Our Jack Russell improved significantly in all the behaviors we worked on.

We highly recommend Elsa Mendes to anyone looking for a competent, dedicated dog trainer who is truly committed to the well-being of dogs and their families. It was, without a doubt, an excellent investment.

Elsa worked with my husband and me when we adopted our Jack Russell Terrier, and her guidance was invaluable. She is an exceptionally knowledgeable dog behaviorist who truly understands canine behavior, instincts, and every stage of a dog's development.

Every piece of advice she gave us turned out to be exactly right. From recommending the best toys, leashes, and potty-training supplies to helping us understand our puppy's behaviors and how to respond to them, her expertise made the entire experience much less stressful.

We learned so much from working with Elsa and feel much more confident as dog owners because of her. We recommend her without hesitation to anyone looking for thoughtful, practical, and highly effective guidance with their dog.

Elsa was excellent with Bolota! Very attentive and available to answer questions. We noticed improvements in his behavior with the strategies we learned to apply in our daily lives. I recommend her work to anyone who wants to better understand their dog.

About a year ago, we adopted a small dog whom we named August. Although he demonstrated unparalleled gentleness and kindness from the start, he presented significant behavioral challenges in other areas, for which we were not entirely prepared.

After much research on canine behavior in search of solutions and not finding any, we decided that the best course of action would be to find someone who could help us on this journey. I can say, without a doubt, that we couldn't have chosen anyone better than Elsa!

Today, after all the support, knowledge, and tools she has given us, August's stress, anxiety, and reactivity levels have practically disappeared, opening doors for the blossoming of everything that is his true nature: that of a calm and fulfilled dog who has gradually learned to leave his past traumas behind and live a happier and fuller life.

We extend our sincere gratitude to Elsa for all the support, understanding, patience, and attention given to us and August on this journey.

Our experience with Elsa was simply spectacular. From the first contact, she showed enormous professionalism, patience, and above all, a true love for animals.
With our puppy Bao, who was only 4 months old, she helped us and educated us not only on teaching commands and routines, but mainly on better understanding Bao's behavior and knowing how to act in each situation.
She explained everything clearly, practically, and adapted to Bao's age, now at 7 months, giving us tools to create a balanced, calm, and happy relationship.

Our goal has always been to live in harmony with Bao, to remain in sync in family life so that we can all be happy!

Thanks to Elsa's guidance, we gained much more confidence in our daily lives and saw a huge evolution in our little Bao's behavior.

We wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone who wants to train their dog with respect, affection, and real results. Elsa is an incredible professional who truly made a difference in our lives and in our Bao's!

Thank you 🤩 Elsa! We'll stay in touch! Kisses

Elsa has been with Pixie since she was 3 months old. We did the Puppy program and I couldn't recommend it more! She gave us a range of tools that, in addition to the practical results, helped us have a better and more peaceful relationship with our puppy. Thank you, Elsa!!

Elsa accompanied me and Zeca from when he was 3 months old until he entered adolescence. I did the Puppy Program and received many tips and tools to deal with the challenges of having a puppy at home.
It gave us an understanding of how dogs are and act, which allowed us to deal with the most stressful moments and when we felt less capable.
Thank you, Elsa, for your availability and teachings.

We have adopted an extremely traumatized dog without being prepared for it. Very grateful that we asked Elsa for help. She guided, supported and trained us (mainly us and not the dog 🤣) through this difficult process. Thank you again! Not sure we would be able to make it without her. …
Extremely attentive and caring, but above all an excellent professional. We were surprised by her organization and explanations, always delivered with great wisdom and pedagogical tact.

I really liked Elsa's work. She helped me a lot in promoting the well-being of my dogs with fundamental advice on toys, food, and games. She teaches dogs using positive methods without punishment, which is what I wanted. She taught me how to walk them on a leash and what to do to prevent them from jumping on my bed during the night. I recommend her. There are many things that we, dog owners, don't know how to do, and it's important to have help from someone who does.

Elsa was undoubtedly the best choice for what I was looking for.
Missy was a Yorkshire Terrier with anxiety issues, which caused her to be very protective (of food, clothing, or even people), both at home and on the street, barking a lot. Working with Elsa helped us understand the causes of this anxiety, and it decreased significantly. Consequently, she stopped exhibiting the behaviors that bothered us, and both our daily lives and hers improved considerably!

We asked for help training our dog Nala and we couldn't be happier.
She is super professional, caring, patient, and very competent.
She helped us better understand Nala's behavior and improve our communication with her.
We are very grateful for the work and the results — the difference is really noticeable!
If you are looking for someone trustworthy to look after your dog, you can count on her completely.

Elsa was fundamental in Zara's development. As a puppy who came to me at 3 months old, already with some traumas and fears, and being my first dog, her support was essential. Problems such as excessive biting, coping well with separation, and managing to have a controlled dog on the street and healthier in terms of canine socialization were undoubtedly the greatest contributions.
I am extremely grateful for her complete availability, going beyond 5 sessions as she was always available for any questions. Excellent support and service.

Hello.
Here's a summary of our experience.
It was the best thing that could have happened to us and to Lord.
Bravo Elsa! Everything you passed on to us in terms of knowledge, guidance, and motivation, and the way you did it, always calm and efficient, took us further.
We know each other better today. We have tools to evolve and valuable tips on time management and nutrition. Nothing was imposed, nor was the result instantaneous. The training was a conscious, gradual process that, in time, bore and continues to bear fruit.
The overall assessment is very positive. I highly recommend it! Thank you!
Inês

Elsa is a great person. She came to us to help with the information about early development of our puppy. It was really useful. We got a lot of different tips and ideas. Thank you very much. Love from Yoda and Irina
Elsa did a great job with my very anxious rescue dog- she gave me clear, written plans with videos and articles and was always responsive to questions. Highly recommend!

Elsa was recommended to us by a friend when we were still thinking about getting a dog. Since we already had 3 cats, we kept postponing this dream (ours and especially our 11-year-old daughter's). Elsa's contribution was fundamental, starting with choosing the breed, considering cohabitation with the cats and our lifestyle. The Puppy Program was ideal for the first 6 months with Pipoca (an adorable Maltese Bichon). The puppy's integration with the cats was super smooth, and Elsa's support throughout this period allowed us to adapt our routines without constraints. Thank you, Elsa, for your dedication and professionalism!
